# Pull Request

## Description
Brief description of the changes in this PR.

## Semantic Versioning Impact
**Required**: This PR must have one of these labels or title prefixes:

### Labels (choose one):
- [ ] `major` - Breaking changes (v1.0.0 → v2.0.0)
- [ ] `minor` - New features (v1.0.0 → v1.1.0)
- [ ] `patch` - Bug fixes (v1.0.0 → v1.0.1)
- [ ] `no-release` - No version bump (docs, CI, tests)

### Title Prefixes (alternative to labels):
- `breaking:` or `major:` - Breaking changes
- `feat:` or `minor:` - New features
- `fix:` or `patch:` - Bug fixes
- `docs:` or `ci:` or `test:` - No release needed

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) → **patch**
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) → **minor**
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected) → **major**
- [ ] Documentation update → **no-release**
- [ ] Performance improvement → **patch**
- [ ] Code refactoring → **patch**

## Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have tested the CLI functionality manually

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have run `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy`

## Performance Impact
- [ ] No performance impact
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Potential performance regression (explain below)

## Breaking Changes
If this is a breaking change, please describe the impact and migration path for existing users.

## Additional Notes
Any additional information that reviewers should know.
